footer.tagline: Handpicked fiction, non-fiction, and everything in between — curated for readers who take their books seriously.

featured-books.title: The Cartographer of Lost Hours
featured-books.author: Elena Vasquez
featured-books.description: A sweeping debut about a mapmaker who discovers her late grandmother's secret correspondence hidden inside antique atlases.

featured-books.title: Quiet Algorithms
featured-books.author: James Okafor
featured-books.description: A near-future thriller exploring what happens when an AI trained on humanity's greatest novels begins writing its own.

featured-books.title: The Bread & Salt Diaries
featured-books.author: Mira Holst
featured-books.description: A James Beard Award-winning chef traces her family's migration through the recipes that survived every border crossing.

featured-books.title: Inheritance of Storms
featured-books.author: Callum Reyes
featured-books.description: Set across three generations of a Basque fishing family, this is a novel about loyalty, loss, and the sea's long memory.

featured-books.title: How to Think Like a Naturalist
featured-books.author: Dr. Priya Anand
featured-books.description: A field guide to slowing down and reading the living world around you, from a celebrated wildlife biologist.

bestsellers.title: The Midnight Archivist
bestsellers.author: Saoirse Flynn
bestsellers.description: A Dublin librarian stumbles upon a decades-old murder hidden inside a returned book's annotations. Over 12,000 copies sold.

bestsellers.title: Borrowed Light
bestsellers.author: Theo Nakamura
bestsellers.description: A quiet, devastating novel about two estranged siblings who reconnect while clearing out their childhood home.

bestsellers.title: Empire of Roots
bestsellers.author: Adaeze Obi
bestsellers.description: A richly imagined epic following a West African botanist whose plant specimens reshape the course of colonial-era science.

bestsellers.title: The Pragmatist's Guide to Almost Everything
bestsellers.author: Harriet Bloom
bestsellers.description: Sharp, funny, and genuinely useful — the rare self-help book that respects your intelligence.

bestsellers.title: Children of the Slow River
bestsellers.author: Yusuf Demirel
bestsellers.description: Longlisted for the International Booker Prize, this novel follows four strangers whose lives converge on a single night in Istanbul.

bestsellers.title: Starfall Academy: The Obsidian Gate
bestsellers.author: Cassidy Park
bestsellers.description: The third instalment in the beloved Starfall series — darker, bolder, and impossible to read in one sitting.

book-grid.title: The Midnight Library
book-grid.author: Matt Haig
book-grid.description: A dazzling novel about all the lives we could have lived, and the one that matters most.

book-grid.title: Educated
book-grid.author: Tara Westover
book-grid.description: A memoir of a woman who grew up in the mountains of Idaho and went on to earn a PhD from Cambridge.

book-grid.title: Project Hail Mary
book-grid.author: Andy Weir
book-grid.description: A lone astronaut must save Earth from disaster in this propulsive, feel-good thriller.

book-grid.title: Atomic Habits
book-grid.author: James Clear
book-grid.description: Tiny changes, remarkable results: a proven framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones.

book-grid.title: The Name of the Wind
book-grid.author: Patrick Rothfuss
book-grid.description: The riveting first-person narrative of Kvothe, a legendary figure even in his own time.

book-grid.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
book-grid.author: Yuval Noah Harari
book-grid.description: A bold, panoramic view of the history of our species from the Stone Age to the twenty-first century.

book-grid.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
book-grid.author: Delia Owens
book-grid.description: A haunting tale of a young woman who raised herself in the marshes of North Carolina.

book-grid.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
book-grid.author: Douglas Adams
book-grid.description: The comedic sci-fi classic following Arthur Dent's improbable journey across the universe.

book-grid.title: Becoming
book-grid.author: Michelle Obama
book-grid.description: An intimate, powerful, and inspiring memoir by the former First Lady of the United States.

book-grid.title: Normal People
book-grid.author: Sally Rooney
book-grid.description: A tender, unflinching story of mutual fascination between two young people in contemporary Ireland.

book-grid.title: The Body: A Guide for Occupants
book-grid.author: Bill Bryson
book-grid.description: A witty and illuminating tour of the human body and the science that keeps us alive.

book-grid.title: Circe
book-grid.author: Madeline Miller
book-grid.description: The spellbinding story of the witch of Greek myth — her origins, her powers, and her place in a world of gods and monsters.

book-grid.title: Think Again
book-grid.author: Adam Grant
book-grid.description: A guide to the surprising science of intellectual humility and the power of knowing what you don't know.

book-grid.title: The Thursday Murder Club
book-grid.author: Richard Osman
book-grid.description: Four unlikely friends in a retirement village meet weekly to solve cold cases — until a real murder lands on their doorstep.

book-grid.title: Dune
book-grid.author: Frank Herbert
book-grid.description: The epic saga of politics, religion, and survival on the desert planet Arrakis.

book-grid.title: The Alchemist
book-grid.author: Paulo Coelho
book-grid.description: A fable about following your dreams, told through the journey of a young Andalusian shepherd.

book-grid.title: Klara and the Sun
book-grid.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
book-grid.description: A luminous novel narrated by an Artificial Friend observing the human world with quiet, precise wonder.

book-grid.title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
book-grid.author: Mark Manson
book-grid.description: A counterintuitive approach to living a good life by embracing limitation rather than chasing positivity.
